{{Top|leg}}
'''Meteorologists''' were individuals who studied and predicted weather patterns. Meteorologists were particularly in need on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to predict storms that could threaten air traffic around the platform. The [[Storm Guard]] were based out of [[Kerros Tower]] and had full authority to ground all modes of transportation. The [[Meri]] [[Honn Dangel]] worked on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] as a meteorologist, using his species innate talent for weather prediction.<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>
